lead: Laredo plumbing deals with extreme heat, hard water and slab homes. PipeMend sends licensed local plumbers across Laredo.
risk: hard water scale, slab leaks and water heater wear
risk_short: hard water, slab leaks and water heaters
why: Downtown and the Heights have homes from the early 1900s with galvanized supply lines and cast-iron drains. Most of north and south Laredo was built more recently on slabs.
Summer heat often tops 100 degrees, which wears out garage water heaters. Rare hard freezes burst exposed and attic pipes.
water: Laredo treats water from the Rio Grande. It is hard, so scale builds up in water heaters and on fixtures. Watch for city boil water notices after line breaks.
tips: Insulate attic and exposed pipes before winter.
Watch your water bill for slab leak signs.
areas: PipeMend works in Downtown, the Heights, North Laredo, South Laredo, Del Mar, San Isidro and every other Laredo neighborhood.
permits: Plumbing permits come from the City of Laredo Building Development Services, and plumbers must hold a Texas license.

faq.a: Yes. Laredo's water comes from the Rio Grande, which carries a lot of dissolved minerals. Scale builds up in water heaters and on fixtures, so yearly flushing helps.
